replace.find: He puffed gentle smoke near the hive door. "Come. Watch first."
replace.with: He puffed gentle smoke near the hive door. "Smoke keeps the bees calm. Come. Watch first."

replace.find: She walked straight, wiggled, turned, came back, wiggled again.
replace.with: She wiggled as she walked straight ahead, then turned and looped back, and wiggled straight ahead again.

replace.find: Wumpini looked at the sun. She looked at her arrow.
replace.with: Wumpini shaded her eyes and glanced toward the sun, never straight at it. She looked at her arrow.

replace.find: Maybe the water pot flowers. Maybe the garden.
replace.with: Maybe the flowers by the water pots. Maybe the garden.

notes: Made the child glance near the sun rather than stare at it, placed the waggle inside the straight run, added that smoke calms bees, and smoothed 'water pot flowers'. Every other bee fact checked true, so nothing else changed.

replace.find: I took it up. Two hundred orbits.
replace.with: I took it up. Two thousand orbits.

replace.find: "You were eighteen. I was angry you wanted more."
replace.with: "You were twenty-three. I was angry you wanted more."

replace.find: Her skin was cool from the capsule, her palm calloused in new places.
replace.with: Her skin was clammy and cool in the night air, her palm calloused in new places.

replace.find: Stay clear, they said. Chi switched it low.
replace.with: Stay clear, they said. Chi switched it low and sent her nephew to the bow to watch for the navy's lights.

notes: Changed orbits to fit months in space, fixed Tuyen's age at leaving to fit forty-three and twenty years, removed the cool-skin/hot-capsule clash, gave the nephew somewhere to be during the talk, and spelled metres to match the title. I kept the unaccented romanised names, which are used consistently.
